description.narrative: Based in Guyana, Red Thread is a multiracial independent women's organization that organizes with women, beginning with grassroots women, to cross divides and transform their conditions. Their advocacy work and programs are mostly focused on women's unwaged and low-waged caring work; all forms of violence; building solidarity among women across divides; and opposing all forms of discrimination. They provide women with the information, skills, and other support they need to fight against economic, social, and political injustices. The grant will support the following specific priorities: - Organizational costs such as staff salaries, transportation, bank fees, utilities, office insurance, office supplies, mobile phone data, and training for their staff and members; - Meeting/ workshop-related costs such as transportation, stipends, meals, child care, and others.
